passage.text: Booha visits Nuppi's new home. It is an apartment on the second floor. They take off their shoes at the entrance. The living room has a balcony, and the dining room is next to the kitchen. Nuppi's bedroom and the bathroom are down the hall. From the balcony, Booha can see a house with a yard and garden. He likes the apartment because every room feels warm and bright.

comprehension.q: Which floor is Nuppi's apartment on?
Where do they take off their shoes?
What can Booha see from the balcony?
choices: a house with a yard and garden

passage.text: Booha cleans his room before Mimo comes. He makes the bed and puts his books on the bookshelf. A lamp and computer are on the desk. The chair is on a soft rug. Booha puts his clothes in the closet. In the kitchen, the milk is in the refrigerator, and soup is in the microwave. The washing machine is running. When Mimo arrives, they sit on the sofa and watch TV under the air conditioner.

passage.text: Saturday is housework day. Booha cleans his room, sweeps the floor, and uses the vacuum. Mimo mops the kitchen and washes the dishes. Nuppi does the laundry and folds the clothes. Mister Happy takes out the trash and recycles cans and bottles. Then they water the plants, feed the pet, make the beds, and set the table. Everyone helps, so the work finishes before lunch.

comprehension.q: Why does the work finish before lunch?

passage.text: Booha draws his dream house. It is big, bright, quiet, and cozy. The rooftop has a small garden. There is a playroom for Mimo and a home office for Nuppi. The house has plenty of storage space, so every room stays clean. It is eco-friendly and safe. The neighborhood is near the station and allows pets. Booha smiles because his dream home has a place for every friend.

comprehension.q: Why do the rooms stay clean?

choices: The house has space for every friend
